name: erlkonig
description: Goals, wiki, journal, people, files and messages in the Erlkonig pile on this computer. Needs the Erlkonig app, which owns the pile and keeps it in sync.

interface.shortDescription: Your goals, wiki and journal in the Erlkonig pile on this computer
interface.longDescription: Connects to the already-running Erlkonig app on this computer. Everything is kept in one append-only pile that the app owns and, when you set it up, syncs with your other computers and your team. Quitting the app disconnects its tools; the plugin never starts a backend.
defaultPrompt: Write what we just decided into the wiki.
